scenario: A digital newsroom editor reviews a submitted article tip that originates from a corporate press release distributed via a wire service. The pipeline extracts and cleans the article content, runs statistical text-authenticity analysis to determine whether the writing is editorial or machine-generated promotional copy, and produces a formal news-vs-PR classification report that governs whether the piece is published as independent journalism or labeled as sponsored/paid content requiring a disclosure tag.
info_flow: web-scraper fetches and cleans the article URL, returning structured text with metadata → nlp-toolkit analyzes the text for AI/promotional-content signals and produces an authenticity verdict → reporting compiles both outputs into a news-vs-PR classification report with a publication clearance decision.
